cases.question: ¿Cuánto se egresó por caja registradora en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cm.amount) AS egresos FROM cash_movement cm JOIN cash_session cs ON cs.id = cm.session_id JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY egresos DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja_registradora, COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total_egresado FROM public.cash_movement AS cm JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cm.session_id = cs.id JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND cm.created_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos movimientos y qué cantidad hubo por tipo de movimiento de inventario en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT im.movement_type, COUNT(*) AS movimientos, SUM(im.quantity) AS cantidad FROM inventory_movement im WHERE im.moved_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND im.moved_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY im.movement_type ORDER BY movimientos DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT im.movement_type AS tipo_movimiento, COUNT(*) AS movimientos, SUM(im.quantity) AS cantidad_total FROM public.inventory_movement AS im WHERE im.moved_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND im.moved_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY im.movement_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué productos tuvieron salidas por venta y cuántas unidades en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(im.quantity) AS cantidad FROM inventory_movement im JOIN product p ON p.id = im.product_id WHERE im.movement_type = 'Sale' AND im.moved_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND im.moved_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY cantidad DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, COALESCE(SUM(im.quantity), 0) AS unidades_vendidas FROM public.inventory_movement AS im JOIN public.product AS p ON im.product_id = p.id WHERE im.movement_type = 'Sale' AND im.moved_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND im.moved_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 50
